subject: NimbleCart MAP: execution timeline & final signoff
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Morris <eliot.morris@nimblecart.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: NimbleCart MAP: proposed execution milestones & signature runway

Hi Eliot / Nimble procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive evaluation week. Attached is the MAP we discussed (Nimble_MAP_v3.xlsx) and the current SOW draft for visibility. Key asks from Redwood to close on start date:

- Final executive approval (Nimble) — who will sign and what earliest date can they commit to?
- Procurement & legal redline window — we estimate 48 business hours once the SOW is locked.
- Preferred commencement (customer-facing) date — proposed 2027-01-10 but flexible by 1–2 weeks.

Proposed signoff cadence:
1) Decision call to confirm executive ok and signers (30 min) — this week if possible.
2) DocuSign—redlines accepted then route to signers.
3) Day-zero prep (onboarding plan) scheduled to start 7 calendar days after signature.

Hannah & Laura, looping you both for approvals and to confirm internal legal/ops SLAs.

Next steps: Eliot — can you share the name(s) of the approver and their availability for a 30-min call tomorrow or Friday? Also confirm procurement's review SLA so we can set expectations in the MAP.

Thanks,
Aditya
--
Aditya Rao
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0184
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: Nimble_MAP_v3.xlsx, Nimble-SOW-draft.pdf)

From: Eliot Morris <eliot.morris@nimblecart.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimblecart.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleCart MAP: proposed execution milestones & signature runway

Aditya — thanks, useful summary. Quick answers:

- Executive approver is Kate Brannon (CPO). She is available for a 30-min decision call Friday 12/11 at 2:30pm PT or Monday 12/14 at 11:00am PT.
- Procurement SLA: we typically complete commercial review within 48 hours for standard SOWs, legal redlines may add 1–2 business days.
- Preferred start date: Kate is aiming for the first full week of January; 2027-01-10 is doable if we sign by 12/16.

I attached a short procurement checklist in-line (see Nimble_MAP_v3.xlsx). Can you confirm what the internal sign path looks like at Redwood? Laura / Hannah — who will be the internal owner to route the DocuSign once Kate signs?

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Morris <eliot.morris@nimblecart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Legal <legal@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleCart MAP: proposed execution milestones & signature runway

Thanks Eliot — great clarity. A couple of internal notes and a proposed binding timeline:

- Internal owner: Hannah will own routing on our side and I will coordinate legal/ops prep.
- Legal review: allow 48 business hours after we receive the final SOW. If redlines are minor we can expedite to 24 hours.
- DocuSign routing: once Kate signs on Nimble side, Hannah will trigger DocuSign to our exec signers (CRO + VP Legal). We need both signatures to create a valid PO path for Dedicated capacity.

Proposed final schedule (assuming sign-by 2026-12-16):
- 12/15 — mutual final SOW confirmed (by EOD Nimble).
- 12/16 — Kate to sign; Procurement confirms commercial items.
- 12/17 — Redwood legal and exec sign off via DocuSign; internal ops schedule onboarding kickoff.
- 12/27 — internal preflight checks complete (holiday buffer).
- 01/10 — customer-facing commencement (training + pilot ramp).

If Nimble cannot commit to 12/16 signature, please indicate feasible sign date and we will shift the onboarding window accordingly. I will attach a short checklist for our onboarding team after we finalize the SOW.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Onboarding, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(Attachment referenced: onboarding-checklist-template.docx)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eliot Morris <eliot.morris@nimblecart.com>, Procurement <procurement@nimblecart.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NimbleCart MAP: proposed execution milestones & signature runway

Eliot / Kate / Procurement team — quick update from Redwood:

We reviewed the MAP and SOW. On behalf of the exec committee I confirm: GREENLIGHT — we are prepared to proceed on the proposed plan with the following commitments:

- Redwood will accept a signature cadence as follows: Nimble signs by 2026-12-16, Redwood execs sign by 2026-12-17 via DocuSign.
- Start date targeted 2027-01-10; ops to run a holiday buffer and begin day-zero prep on 2026-12-27.
- Hannah will trigger DocuSign after Kate's signature; routing will go to CRO (Markus Klein) and VP Legal (Kimberly Park).

Eliot — please confirm Kate's ability to sign 12/16 and, if that works, we will send the DocuSign envelope tonight after you share the final SOW PDF. If Kate needs a different signer path please call me directly — +1 (415) 555-0142.

One small ask: please include a single clause clarifying data retention for evaluation logs (we recommend 30 days) — our legal team flagged that for the final SOW.

Thanks all — excited to get Nimble live.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
VP, North America Field Sales, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
(Triggers: will send DocuSign envelope upon final SOW from Nimble)
